name: io.github.BartWaardenburg/recraft-mcp
title: Recraft
description: AI image generation, transformation, and style management via the Recraft API

environmentVariables.name: RECRAFT_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable: generation, processing, styles. Default: all

environmentVariables.name: RECRAFT_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Cache TTL in seconds. Use 0 to disable. Default: 120

environmentVariables.name: RECRAFT_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum retry attempts on rate limit (429). Default: 3
